questions.q:
In a coded language, "ARK LAR MOS" is coded as "CITY SHOW STOPPER", "KIY CXV ARK" is coded as "SHOW WAS NICE" and "LAR AXQ KIY" is coded as "CITY WAS FLOODED". What is the code for 'AXQ CXV' ?

एक कोडित भाषा में , "ARK LAR MOS" को "CITY SHOW STOPPER" के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, "KIY CXV ARK" को "SHOW WAS NICE" के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है और "LAR AXQ KIY" को "CITY WAS FLOODED" के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है| 'AXQ CXV' को किस रूप में कोडित किया जायेगा?

"ARK LAR MOS" is coded as "CITY SHOW STOPPER"..............(1)

"KIY CXV ARK" is coded as "SHOW WAS NICE"..................(2)

"LAR AXQ KIY" is coded as "CITY WAS FLOODED".............(3)

From (1) and (2), ARK == SHOW.

From (1) and (3), LAR == CITY.

From (2) and (3), KIY == WAS.

From (1), MOS == STOPPER.

From (2), CXV == NICE.

From (3), AXQ == FLOODED.

Here, the code foe 'AXQ CXV' == FLOODED NICE.
